interpretation: All metrics compare answers with provisional references. They do not independently establish domain correctness.

priority_loss.rationale: Proposed asymmetric severity weights: under-prioritizing an urgent reference is costlier than over-prioritizing a normal one. These weights have not been validated against operational costs and are not dollars.

invalid_output: No classification credit; maximum priority loss. Per-field value matches remain descriptive diagnostics only.
uncertainty: Descriptive counts and rates only. No row-independent confidence intervals, significance tests or production generalization claim.
explanations_and_confidence: Not requested or scored. The answer contract remains queue, priority and escalate.
